summary: Return artists' tracks as sub‑entity of each artist
description: Returns each matching artist with an embedded list of their tracks. Supports filtering, ordering and pagination. Since February 2021 a new boolean field 'audiodownload_allowed' is returned for each track to indicate if download can be offered. In April 2022 the 'audiodownload' field will be empty when this flag is false. Use 'track_type' to include singles (track_type=single) or album tracks (track_type=albumtrack); by default only album tracks are returned.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The results formatting type.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200). Keyword 'all' is limited to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Append _asc or _desc for direction; defaults are asc except rating fields which default to desc.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' in the header with the total number of rows without limit/offset.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact artist name.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search an artist by name (artist_name matching *searchquery*).

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists with an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on artist join date; format 'yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd'.

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: One or more track IDs.

parameters.name: track_name
parameters.description: A track name.

parameters.name: track_type
parameters.description: Select tracks of a certain type. Default is albumtrack only.

parameters.name: album_datebetween
parameters.description: Filter albums by creation date; format 'yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd'.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs.

parameters.name: album_name
parameters.description: An album name.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Cover size in pixels.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field. Defaults to audioformat or mp32.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request (status, code, warnings, results_count, results_fullcount if requested).

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of artist objects, each containing fields like id, name, website, joindate, image and a nested 'tracks' array.

notes: The boolean field 'audiodownload_allowed' is returned for each track; when false the 'audiodownload' string will be empty (as of April 2022).
Singles have empty album_* fields; use 'track_type' to include them explicitly.
All tracks have an 'image' field – for album tracks it is the same as 'album_image'.
